standalone.privacy.html.7: This edition does not require login. Your conversations are private by default. Visitors can see them only if you publish them.
standalone.privacy.html.9: The operator stores conversations, character directives, emotions, jury reports, costs, and reviews in private server storage. Your history is associated with a random identifier in an HttpOnly cookie. A separate session protects requests against forgery. Keep this identifier private. Clearing browser data can remove your access to private history; there is no account for recovery from another browser.
standalone.privacy.html.11: You may use your own OpenRouter key. It is kept in this browser’s sessionStorage and sent to the laboratory server and then to OpenRouter to execute your requests. The raw key is not saved in conversation history; a fingerprint binds each experiment to its funding source. Experiments have no daily limit, while the key’s balance and provider limits still apply. Displayed costs are provider-reported and may be incomplete when a request has no reported cost.
standalone.privacy.html.13: Case information, role instructions, and spoken context are sent to models through OpenRouter. Neither actor sees the other actor’s fictional thinking notes. Keep secrets and sensitive personal data out of the simulation. Review
standalone.privacy.html.15: and the policies of the model providers.
standalone.privacy.html.17: You may publish a fully evaluated conversation in the public gallery. Visitors can then see the conversation, results, reviews, and costs, and it becomes read-only. You may permanently delete your private or published conversations from the laboratory, including their reviews and records. Deletion does not cover copies retained by visitors or model providers under their policies. Conversations are excluded from code-deployment backups.
standalone.privacy.html.19: Contact the operator of your installation for privacy requests. For questions about the original project,
standalone.privacy.html.21: . Keep passwords and API keys out of messages.
